authority: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (MoA&FW), Government of India

localized_calamities.channel: Crop Insurance App (geotagged photos) or Portal pmfby.gov.in or Toll-Free 14447
localized_calamities.assessment_method: Individual farm-level survey within 10 days by Joint Assessment Committee

post_harvest_losses.condition: Cut-and-spread condition in field for drying

widespread_perils.assessment_method: Area Approach based on Notified Insurance Unit (Gram Panchayat / Block)
widespread_perils.settlement_mechanism: Direct benefit transfer based on State Crop Cutting Experiments (CCE). Individual 72-hour notice NOT applicable.

schemes.benefit_amount: ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 directly via DBT
mandatory_prerequisites: Aadhaar eKYC completed on pmkisan.gov.in (OTP or Biometric / Facial recognition)
Land record seeding verified in State Revenue records (Bhulekh / Patta / Chitta)
Bank account seeded with Aadhaar and NPCI DBT-enabled
statutory_exclusions: Current or former holders of constitutional posts
Serving or retired government / public sector employees
Income tax payers in last assessment year

schemes.name_ta: மண் வள அட்டைத் திட்டம் (Soil Health Card)
schemes.benefit_summary: Issues custom macro and micronutrient dosage recommendations per crop to prevent excess urea application and reduce cultivation costs by 15-25%.

subsidies.individual_farmers: 40% to 50% subsidy (up to 50% for SC/ST/Small/Marginal/Women farmers) on tractors, rotavators, power tillers, drone sprayers
subsidies.custom_hiring_centers: Up to 40% financial assistance (up to ₹10–24 Lakh) for FPOs, cooperative societies, and rural entrepreneurs to establish Custom Hiring Centers (CHC)
